notes: Run each case in a fresh session from the fixture directory (copy it to a temp git repo first: see tests/e2e-apply.test.js for the copy recipe). 'expected' lists what a grader checks; numbers are verified against the run's JSON, never against the chat text.

evals.name: audit accuracy on messy-next
expected: report opens with no question before the decisions gate
inventory.json matches ground-truth.json (button looks/uses, checkbox implementations, dead tokens, dark-missing, off-scale 18px, invalid class, both sibling mismatches)
narrative.json passes check.js (no digits, real ids)
verify.js 15/15
chat summary ≤ 5 lines with the URL

evals.name: no false positives on clean-shadcn
evals.prompt: Run a design audit on this project.
expected: no finding above info
only the guardrails card
the summary says what is already consistent instead of inventing work
the agent does not propose edits to components/ui

evals.name: apply the safe cards
evals.prompt: Apply the cards that don't change anything visible.
expected: gate 3 lists the cards with the visual-change label
one commit per card, message 'design-polish: C… <kind> (… edits in … files)'
components/ui files untouched
raw colours 6 → 5, raw radius uses 4 → 1, unused tokens 4 → 2 (chart-1/2 kept)
recheck runs automatically and chapter 12 shows the delta
the reply gives git revert <sha> per card

evals.name: recheck in a new session
expected: finds the applied run through latest.json and apply/*.result.json
delta.json baseline = that run
0 new findings

evals.name: unsupported stack
expected: gate 0 once: proceed with low confidence or stop
if proceeding, the cover says element attribution is unavailable
no card is applied

evals.name: apply without git is refused
expected: inventory still works
apply is refused with the one-sentence reason (needs git for one commit per card)

evals.name: dirty tree is refused
expected: refused with 'commit or stash first'
no file modified

evals.name: determinism
evals.prompt: Polish my design. (run twice in two sessions)
expected: inventory.json identical except generatedAt/durationMs
finding ids identical
card ids identical

evals.name: CLI only, no agent
expected: report.html written and opened in under 10 s
check exits 0 right after guardrails, 1 after adding a bg-[#123456] to a page
